audit.whatIsWrong: Six of the seven chart rows contradict the whys[] written directly under them. The file says Neeko wins Level 1, Skill at 2, Neeko at 6, Maokai at first item and Maokai at 2+ items — while the whys say Level 1 is 'even', Level 2 is Maokai out-trading her, Level 6 is Maokai 'reclaiming the lane', first item is 'her Q poke outpaces Sap Magic', and 2+ items is 'she out-scales hard'.
audit.why: The packet chart (Skill / Maokai / Maokai / Neeko / Maokai / Neeko / Neeko) matches the prose exactly, and the 47.17% win rate matches a lane Neeko owns from first item onward. The mechanical basis: Blooming Burst reaches 800 against Twisted Advance's 525, so from Levels 4-5 she wins spacing; and Pop Blossom's preparation gives Maokai a Nature's Grasp interrupt window at 6.
audit.corrected: All six rows flipped to the packet shape in both layers, with matching ratings and rewritten whys.

audit.why: Four spikes present: Lvl 2-3 root chain, Lvl 6 as the Pop Blossom interrupt, 1st item as her poke takeover, Late as her pick threat. Consistent with the corrected chart.

Neeko's passive breaks on immobilizing CC, which the Maokai kit supplies twice.
